card.name: Inside enzyme and protein names
card.fires_on: Partway through enzyme and clotting-protein names, such as the A or 1 inside UGT1A3 or UGT1A1, the dot in prothrombin fragment 1.2, or the middle of plasminogen and quinaprilat.

modes.label: UGT enzyme codes
modes.description: The letter or digit inside UGT1A-style glucuronosyltransferase names.

modes.label: Clotting protein names
modes.description: The middle of plasminogen or the dot in prothrombin fragment 1.2.

card.writes: It suppresses enzyme-word endings such as enzyme and ase, so it may stop the name from being closed off with the word enzyme.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of enzyme and blood-protein names, before the name is finished.
